svg.title: Proxmox + Ceph monitoring: Prometheus / Grafana and Zabbix
svg.desc: Proxmox + Ceph clusters are read by pve_ceph_extra_exporter on a monitor host; Prometheus scrapes it and Grafana shows it, Zabbix reads the same exporter over HTTP and polls zabbix-agent2 on the nodes. Bottom: how to check each part on the servers and which values must match.
svg.text: Proxmox + Ceph monitoring · Prometheus → Grafana · Zabbix
Moving arrows = data flow. Prometheus and Zabbix pull; the monitor host pushes config (SSH) and dashboards (Grafana API). Bottom: how to check it on the servers.
Health · PG map · OSD · pools · latency
Optional local mode (on a Ceph node)
Remote mode: nothing is installed on the nodes,
One per cluster, every metric on one port:
Mgr metrics + Proxmox + recovery % + HA groups
HA colors · 5 min: new HA group → regenerate + import
HA Groups: one color per CPU type (.ha-colors.json)
Menu 27: agent2 + cron + restful key on every node
Checked by promtool, restored on error
One Prometheus datasource per site → variable $Site
Locked job + datasource · read-only · own folder
Total Health % · OSD · pools · latency · nodes · HA Groups
Proxmox Ceph by FIX NHANH exporter
HTTP, no agent · LLD nodes / OSDs / pools / collectors
Ceph by Zabbix agent 2 + health fallback
Zabbix polls zabbix-agent2 :10050 on every node
Health status · Detailed alarms · Capacity · Used · PG inconsistent
OUT · DOWN · UP · IN · OSD low / high · Used per $class
Nodes: CPU · RAM · Uptime · HA · HA Groups (color per CPU type)
OSD class details · Ceph pool details (size · avail · %used · PG)
Apply latency graph · per $class: nvme 15/25 · ssd 50/100 · hdd 100/200 ms
Ceph Status · Total Health % (100% when clean) · Recovery Speed
Collector up / error · Data age · Mode local / remote · Version
• OSDs up / in · quorum · nodes online
• Nodes: up · CPU · RAM · uptime · HA
Thresholds are macros, editable per host
HOW TO CHECK IT ON THE SERVERS
Top to bottom: a step fails → fix it before looking further
HA Groups: same CPU type = same color
New host → its color within 5 minutes
Run zabbix_get on Zabbix, cat on a node
COMPARE: THE SAME VALUE IN EVERY PLACE
Equal within ~1 minute; different → stale exporter, wrong job / port, or wrong Zabbix host
OSDs UP · OSDs IN · OSDs DOWN
Ceph: OSDs up · Ceph: OSDs in
Recovery: Grafana Recovery Speed = Zabbix "Ceph: recovery speed" = "recovery: … MiB/s" in ceph -s
